name: Priyoma Mustafi
bio: Priyoma Mustafi earned her PhD in Economics from the University of Pittsburgh in 2025. She completed her MSc in Economics from Shiv Nadar University and a BA (Hons) in Economics from Jadavpur University. Priyoma’s research interests lie in development economics and behavioral economics. For much of her work, she uses a combination of lab, field, and online experiments, as well as secondary data to address questions about gender, households, and incentives.
